-- Verify fix applied
SELECT id, sequenceKey, touchKey,
  CASE WHEN bodyText LIKE '%3945 Peachtree%' THEN 'STILL BAD' ELSE 'OK' END AS text_status,
  CASE WHEN bodyHtml LIKE '%3945 Peachtree%' THEN 'STILL BAD' ELSE 'OK' END AS html_status
FROM sequenceTemplates
WHERE id IN (60001, 60002, 60003, 60004, 60005);

-- Also check no other templates have the wrong address anywhere
SELECT COUNT(*) AS remaining_bad FROM sequenceTemplates
WHERE bodyText LIKE '%3945 Peachtree%' OR bodyHtml LIKE '%3945 Peachtree%';
